name: GAN356 i Carry 4 3x3 (Frosted)
description: Experience the revolution in smart cubing with the all-new GAN356 i Carry 4 3x3 (Frosted). Packed with cutting-edge refinements and advanced features, this flagship release from GAN takes interactive speedcubing to the next level.
features: Racing-grade performance with a 48-magnet system for ultra-smooth, fast, and stable turns.
Durable frosted finish and optimized internal design for a premium, tactile feel.
Omni-support spherical orbit and honeycomb lubricating surfaces for consistently fluid motion right out of the box.
Cutting-edge 72-gear numerical tuning so you can fine-tune every aspect of your cube's tension and elasticity.
Full 90° corner cutting for effortless alignment and competition-level tolerance.
Now featuring a more compact core, giving you increased stability and responsiveness, plus longer battery life for your sessions.
